definitions.explanation: A thin, non-slip mat used during yoga practice to provide cushioning for the body and grip for the hands and feet. Also widely used for general home stretching, pilates, and core exercises.

examples.japanese: ヨガマット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げた→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧。
examples.english: I spread out the yoga mat on the floor.

notes:
Widely sold in Japan at sports shops, 100-yen stores, and online retailers. Commonly used at home even by people who don't practice yoga formally.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヨガマット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to lay out a yoga mat
- ヨガマット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to spread out a yoga mat
- ヨガマット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丸|まる}める→丸める：11313_marumeru⟧: to roll up a yoga mat
- {厚|あつ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ヨガマット: a thicker yoga mat
- ⟦{滑|すべ}り{止|ど}め→滑り止め：27612_suberidome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ヨガマット: a non-slip yoga mat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧: mat — the generic term; can refer to any kind of mat (doormat, bath mat, exercise mat)
- ⟦トレーニング→トレーニング：00408_toreeningu⟧⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧: training mat — a broader term for exercise mats, often thicker than ヨガマット
- ⟦ピラティス→ピラティス：23097_piratisu⟧⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧: pilates mat — typically thicker than a yoga mat for spine support

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦ヨガ→ヨガ：04737_yoga⟧ has become a mainstream fitness activity in Japan, with many studios and home-practice followers, so ヨガマット is a household item for a significant portion of the population.
